name: Model-Based Systems Engineering
syllabus_body:
SYSEN 5100: Model-Based Systems Engineering

Lectures meet Mon Wed Fri 10:10 – 11:25 AM in Hollister 110.

Office hours: Tuesdays 2:00 to 3:00 PM in Rhodes 240, or by appointment.

Late work

Late work is accepted up to 3 days late with a 10% penalty per day. Illness extensions are considered if you email the instructor within 48 hours of the deadline.

Use of AI

Generative AI tools may be used to understand course material and to check your own work, but not to write submitted answers. Cite any AI use in your submission.

name: Machine Learning
syllabus_body:
CS 5780 Machine Learning

Lectures Mon Wed 1:25 – 2:40 PM, Bailey Hall.

Office hours Thursday 3 to 4 PM, Gates 310.

Problem sets

Problem sets are submitted on Gradescope. Late submissions lose 10% per day for up to 3 days. Illness extensions are considered if you email within 48 hours.

Academic integrity

You may not use AI assistants to produce problem set solutions. Discussing concepts with classmates is fine; write up your own work.
